goal: Improve interaction and UX design for the Denver Museum of Nature & Science, helping families, tourists and members discover the museum, plan a visit and find the right ticket path.
primaryAction: Discover the museum, plan a visit and continue to official DMNS ticketing or member experiences.
aesthetics: A: Walk Into Wonder — architectural gallery compositions, mineral whites, charcoal, authentic museum green, layered spatial depth. B: Wonder, Panel by Panel — ink-and-paper comic bento, condensed type, original illustrated character, native panel transformations.
functionality: Responsive Homepage, Purchase and Visit pages in each concept
Filterable exhibitions and three reusable exhibition detail pages
Native same-document and cross-document View Transitions with unsupported-API and reduced-motion fallbacks
Exhibition interpretation dialogs, navigation directory, finite fossil reveal
Member-aware admission estimate with bounded counters and clear official ticketing handoff
Date and interest-based suggested visit starting point; closure notices and native FAQ disclosures
Preserved comparison shell, viewport controls, direct concept routes, structured feedback

references.takeaways: Implement Walk Into Wonder using the full supplied art direction, spatial grammar, gallery sequence and meaningful native transitions.
Implement Wonder, Panel by Panel from the detailed written bento/comic art direction. The named bento-grid-example.mp4 was not attached and has not been seen.
Real logo, institutional navigation, museum photography, identity and scientific purpose.
Current hours, practical visitor information, accessibility, directions and closure notices.
Separate admission, timed experiences and membership paths. Complete transactions on DMNS.

contentSource: Official DMNS homepage, permanent exhibitions, mission, Visit, Purchase, pricing, directions and accessibility pages checked October 16, 2026. Asset URLs and rights notes in ASSET_SOURCES.md.
constraints: Preserve the established side-by-side comparison visual system.
Existing static HTML/CSS/ES-module stack, no framework migration or added runtime dependency.
Independent redesign study, not an official DMNS service.
Use official published prices as an estimate only; do not invent slot availability or integrate checkout.
No portfolio imagery, content, résumé or personal contact details in the published example.
B video reference not supplied; use written reference and report that limitation.
Core requested pages are Homepage, Purchase, Visit; the exhibition index and three detail views implement the supplied supporting requirements.
Browser automation is unavailable in the managed environment; report unverified interactive QA.

directions.rationale: Use physical gallery cues and layered visual depth to connect emotional discovery with immediate planning.
directions.tradeoffs: Larger editorial images and depth choreography require careful image optimization, motion fallback and mobile simplification.

directions.rationale: Make exploration inviting through strongly bounded panels, illustrated curiosity, finite reveals and clear practical actions.
directions.tradeoffs: Dense panel arrangements require deliberate reading order, mobile composition and stable resting states.
